# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class EquityChandelierExitAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True
        self._equity = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.MINUTE)
        self._atr = self.atr(self._equity.symbol, 14, MovingAverageType.SIMPLE, Resolution.DAILY)
        # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
        # self._atr = AverageTrueRange(14)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._equity, self._atr, Resolution.DAILY)
        # self.register_indicator(self._equity, self._atr, Resolution.DAILY)
        self._trailing_high = self.highest(self._equity, 20, Resolution.DAILY)
        # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
        # self._trailing_high = Highest(20)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._equity, self._trailing_high, Resolution.DAILY)
        # self.register_indicator(self._equity, self._trailing_high, Resolution.DAILY)
        self._stop_loss_multiplier = 3.0
        self._previous_price = self._equity.price
        self._in_position = False
        self.plot_indicator("ATR", self._atr)

    def on_data(self, data: Slice) -> None:
        if not data.bars or not self._atr.is_ready:
            return
        price = self._equity.close
        if not self._in_position:
            if price > self._trailing_high.current.value:
                self._trailing_high.update(price)
            if price > self._atr.current.value * self._stop_loss_multiplier:
                self.set_holdings(self._equity, 1)
                self._in_position = True
        else:
            if price < self._atr.current.value * self._stop_loss_multiplier:
                self.liquidate(self._equity)
                self._in_position = False
            elif price > self._trailing_high.current.value:
                self._trailing_high.update(price)
